directions: Read the following text. Answer the questions below the text by choosing A, B, C or D. Mark your answers on the ANSWER SHEET 1. (10 points)

materials.title: Text 1 · Reading beyond the headline
materials.section: Section II · 阅读理解 Part A

blocks.text: Online headlines can make a small study sound like a universal rule. Careful readers look beyond the headline and ask who took part in the research.
A result may describe one group – without explaining every community. More evidence can change an early conclusion.
Good reading is therefore not a hunt for certainty. It is a habit of matching each claim to the evidence that supports it.

questions.section: Section II · 阅读理解 Part A
questions.stem: According to the first paragraph, careful readers mainly ______.

options.text: ask who took part in the research

questions.explanation: P1 明确说 careful readers 会追问研究者是谁，B 为同义转述。

questions.section: Section II · 阅读理解 Part A
questions.stem: The phrase "one group" in Paragraph 2 suggests that a study result may ______.
questions.explanation: P2 原文 "without explaining every community" 对应 C。

questions.section: Section II · 阅读理解 Part A
questions.stem: What does the writer suggest about an early conclusion?

options.text: It always applies to every community.
It may change when more evidence appears.
It should replace the original research.
It is useful only when it is certain.

questions.explanation: P2 "More evidence can change an early conclusion" 对应 B。

questions.section: Section II · 阅读理解 Part A
questions.stem: According to Paragraph 3, good reading is described as ______.

options.text: a habit of matching claims to evidence

questions.explanation: P3 "a habit of matching each claim to the evidence" 对应 D。

questions.section: Section II · 阅读理解 Part A

warn readers against all online studies

questions.explanation: 全文主旨：把每个论断与支持它的证据对应起来，A 正确。
